parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the response format returned by the server.

loop.description: Whether to enable loop playback for the generated video.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

action.description: Operation type. Use `generate` when creating a video for the first time, and use `extend` when continuing an existing video.

prompt.example: Astronauts shuttle from space to volcano

timeout.description: The timeout for the API return data (unit: seconds).

video_id.description: The unique identifier of the generated video used for the continuation operation (`extend`). If both are specified, `video_id` takes precedence over `video_url`.

video_url.description: The original video URL used for the extend operation (`extend`). If `video_id` is specified at the same time, then `video_id` shall prevail.

enhancement.description: Whether to enable automatic optimization enhancement for the input prompt text, suitable for use when unsure how to write prompt words.

aspect_ratio.description: Generate the aspect ratio of the video, for example `16:9`.

callback_url.description: Webhook callback URL for receiving asynchronous notifications.

end_image_url.description: The URL of the ending frame image, which will be used as the last frame of the generated video.

start_image_url.description: The URL of the starting frame image, which will be used as the first frame of the generated video.
